findings.title: Denial-cache key uses an ambiguous `_` separator, so distinct name/folder pairs can collide
findings.description: `userPermDenialCacheKey` joins `name` and `parent` with `_` and does not escape them. Because folder and resource names are free-form request strings, `name="a_b", parent="c"` and `name="a", parent="b_c"` produce the same key. A cached denial for one resource would then be served for another resource of the same user and action, returning a wrong `Allowed: false` in `Check`. The same concern applies to the `_`-joined `userPermCacheKey` prefix. A length-prefixed or delimiter-escaped encoding would avoid this.

findings.title: NoopCache receiver name `lc` does not match the type
findings.description: The receiver for `NoopCache` methods is named `lc`, which suggests the local cache type. The receiver is unused, so there is no behavioral effect, but `nc` or `c` would match the type.

findings.title: Test local variable `store` shadows the imported `store` package
findings.description: In the "Fallback to the database on cache miss" and "outdated cache" subtests, `store := &fakeStore{...}` shadows the `store` package imported at the file level. It compiles because the package is not referenced after the shadowing in those closures, but it is fragile and reads poorly. Renaming the variable to `fs` or similar would avoid it.
